error[ZBX-E0321]: a host setting --require-host asks for can't be read
  while  reading the host's vm.max_map_count for --require-host
  cause  /proc/sys/vm/max_map_count is not there: this kernel does not expose
         vm.max_map_count
  key    vm.max_map_count
  fix    see what this host has:   zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0321
